create_LossTag_primitive: create a custom loss tag primitive by subclassing LossTag with a loss class and input count
register_dense_layer: register a dense layer pattern using register_dense with output input weight and optional bias
register_conv2d_layer: register a conv2d layer pattern using register_conv2d with output input weight and optional bias
register_scale_and_shift_layer: register a scale and shift layer using register_scale_and_shift with output inputs and boolean flags
register_generic_parameter: register a generic parameter using register_generic to tag it with the generic_tag primitive
